content:
For \(n=14\), the angle-sum equation gives
\[
7(2a+13d)=2160 \implies 2a+13d=\frac{2160}{7},
\]
impossible since the left side is an integer.

More generally,
\[
2a+(n-1)d=360-\frac{720}{n},
\]
so \(n\mid 720\). For \(n\ge 4\), convexity gives
\[
(n-1)d<\frac{720}{n},
\]
and parity requires
\[
(n-1)d\equiv \frac{720}{n}\pmod 2.
\]
Checking divisors of \(720\) with \(n(n-1)<720\), the valid \(n\) are
\[
3,4,5,6,8,9,10,12,15,16,18,
\]
while \(20,24\) fail.

Thus the sum is
\[
3+4+5+6+8+9+10+12+15+16+18=106.
\]
\[
\boxed{106}
\]
